boards.school_name: New Mexico Institute of Mining and Technology
boards.title: Your First Weekend at New Mexico Institute of Mining and Technology, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key first-weekend sequence that starts with campus connection, includes practical shared spaces, and leaves room to explore central Socorro.

cards.title: Start with the Kelly Mine Experience
cards.subtitle: Arrival and campus connection
cards.notes: Use the required new-student program to check in, meet classmates, and orient yourself before planning independent stops around campus.
cards.short_summary: A structured start for arriving students.
cards.evidence_claim: New Mexico Tech describes the Kelly Mine Experience as a required, no-additional-cost jumpstart where incoming students move in, engage in campus life, and connect with resources.
cards.source_title: Kelly Mine Experience | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: For incoming students; follow the published program schedule and check-in instructions.

cards.entity_name: Joseph A. Fidel Student Services Center
cards.title: Get your bearings at Fidel
cards.subtitle: First campus hub stop
cards.notes: Walk through the student union to locate dining, student services, the game room, and gathering areas you may use during the term.
cards.short_summary: One building connects several everyday services.
cards.evidence_claim: New Mexico Tech identifies the Joseph A. Fidel Student Services Center as its student union and lists dining, student-support offices, a game room, an atrium, and open areas.
cards.source_title: Fidel Student Center | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: General weekend building hours listed by NMT are 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; hours can change during holidays and between semesters.

cards.title: Play a round in the NMT Game Room
cards.subtitle: A casual Fidel Center break
cards.notes: Bring your student ID and choose a low-pressure game of ping pong, billiards, board games, or video games with new acquaintances.
cards.short_summary: A free student-ID activity inside Fidel.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT says its Game Room offers board games, video games, ping pong, and billiards, and that New Mexico Tech students play free with student ID.
cards.source_title: Fidel Student Center | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: Listed weekend hours are 1–6 p.m.; confirm on arrival because NMT notes that Fidel hours may change.

cards.title: Set up a study base at Skeen Library
cards.subtitle: Clock tower and group-study spaces
cards.notes: Find a comfortable floor, identify the computer lab and study rooms, and save the library site for research help during your first courses.
cards.short_summary: A practical academic anchor with flexible spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT’s catalog describes the three-story Joseph R. Skeen Library as providing study rooms, group-study areas, a computer lab, and a free coffee bar.
cards.source_title: Joseph R. Skeen Library | New Mexico Tech Catalog
cards.access_notes: Library services and room reservations may have their own availability; check the library website before relying on a particular room.

cards.title: See the Mineral Museum displays
cards.subtitle: Headen Center, NMT campus
cards.notes: Make a daytime visit to the Headen Center galleries and use the displays as a concrete introduction to New Mexico’s geology and mining history.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum focused on minerals and geology.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Mexico Mineral Museum is on the NMT campus in the Headen Center and displays geological, mineralogical, and paleontological materials.
cards.access_notes: The museum lists hours of 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Monday–Friday and 10 a.m.–3 p.m. Saturday; it is closed Sunday and most university holidays.

cards.title: Tour the Rec and Well-Being Center
cards.subtitle: Gym, fitness room, courts, and pool options
cards.notes: Take a daytime walk-through to find the gymnasiums, fitness room, courts, athletic field, and equipment checkout before deciding what to try later.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation hub with varied facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT says its Recreation and Well-Being Center includes multipurpose gymnasiums, a weight and fitness room, bouldering wall, racquetball and squash courts, field, turf court, and sand volleyball pit.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Wellness Center | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: A valid NMT ID or member swipe card is required for entry. Listed weekend hours are Saturday 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–7 p.m.

cards.title: Plan a bouldering-wall session
cards.subtitle: Rec and Well-Being Center
cards.notes: If climbing interests you, ask the recreation staff about the required safety course and schedule it before using the training bouldering wall.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT lists a training bouldering wall at its Recreation and Well-Being Center and requires a safety course for bouldering-wall use.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Wellness Center | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: NMT lists a $5 student safety course; follow staff instructions and facility-access requirements before climbing.

cards.title: Check what is on at Macey Center
cards.subtitle: Campus theater and gallery
cards.notes: Walk by the theater and gallery, then review the official calendar for a performance or public event that fits your first-weekend schedule.
cards.short_summary: A campus venue for performances and events.
cards.evidence_claim: NMT describes Macey Center as a 615-seat theater and conference center on campus with an art gallery and performances among its uses.
cards.source_title: Macey Conference Center | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: Entry and ticketing depend on the particular event; consult the official event listing before attending.

cards.title: Locate the Etscorn Campus Observatory
cards.subtitle: Campus astronomy landmark
cards.notes: Find the observatory in daylight, then watch official astronomy-club or outreach information for an appropriate observing opportunity.
cards.short_summary: A campus observatory connected with student astronomy.
cards.evidence_claim: New Mexico Tech’s Etscorn Campus Observatory is home to the NMT Astronomy Club and is used for education, outreach, teaching, and research.
cards.source_title: Etscorn Campus Observatory | New Mexico Tech
cards.access_notes: Do not assume public drop-in access; use official club or outreach information to identify any open observing opportunity.

cards.title: Close with a Historic Plaza walk
cards.subtitle: Downtown Socorro
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk around the plaza, use the historic-walking-tour material, and note nearby landmarks for a future unhurried visit.
cards.short_summary: A downtown history walk beyond campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Socorro identifies the Historic Plaza as the center of the city’s historic walking tour, which covers three historic districts.
cards.source_title: Historic Plaza: Kittrel Park | Visit Socorro New Mexico
cards.access_notes: Plan this as an outdoor daytime walk and check local conditions before heading out.
